name: Ramada Graand Swiss Sukhumvit 11
detail: I have stayed in many Bangkok hotels and also several of the Soi 11 hotels. This was my first stay at the a Grand Swiss and it is far superior to the others. It's cleaner and more modern. The rooms are well decorated, equipped and very comfortable. The shower was excellent. Breakfast selection was very good. The staff including the carparks attendants, receptionists, security, restaurant and room service were all polite, friendly and attentive. Very, very impressed. I have already re-booked to stay later this month and this will be my hotel of choice moving forward. I wish I had found before.

name: Night Hotel Bangkok - Asoke Sukhumvit 15
detail: I am going to book Dream hotel for the 4th time know!!!! This is the best affordable hotel in Bangkok to my opinion. The hotel is separated in 2 buildings. One hotel is without the swimming pool and the more expensive one (i guess) has the swimming pool. The buildings are 1 minut apart. I have stayed in both of the 2 buildings and they are absolutely great. The rooms are really fabulous and have great comfortable beds. With a nice blue lighting to switch on ore off. They have a perfect airo system. Breakfast is really perfect. You have International foods and Thai dishes. It is a great relaxing get away from Bangkok crowd, but with in 4 minutes you are in the nice crowded area. BTS station is very close, and also great dining area's. Or going out! I already recommended this hotel to two others and they were also very satisfied. So i Will book this for the 4th TIME!!!!!!

name: Diamond Bangkok Apartment
detail: I liked the location. Usually I have stayed in the Banglamphu area, the backpacker place to stay. After staying there for the last 25 years whenever in Bangkok I felt like I needed a change so chose Siam area. I arrived very early, 7am, I was able to take a room at 9am. The staff at reception were not the friendliest, but at least I got my room early. The road in front of the hotel is very busy, but the room was quiet enough. The usual A/C. fridge, T.V. you expect at this price range. Wifi was good. I don't think the hotel had food, but around I found the best street food and cheap but great food restaurants I have found in Bangkok. The hotel is a ten minute walk to the massive MBK shopping mall and the impressive Siam Discovery Centre. I spent hours walking around these places until my feet were aching too much, how wonderful to have a foot massage later! Anyway, back to the hotel, it's a bit on the expensive side for me but is good value for money. For short stays in Bangkok with plenty of local shopping options I can recommend and will likely stay there again. Also close to the BTS Skytrain and Jim Thompson house.

name: The Bless Hotel & Residence
detail: what can i not say about this hotel? a small tucked away yet very convenient hotel in bangkok to stay in. the staff are all friendly and warm, the rooms are more then what you expect with spacious rooms, kitchen, living, bedroom and bathroom. its like a superior 1 bedroom hotel room with all the perks of a service apartment. if i was staying on a long term basis in bangkok, i could live at bless residence for months comfortably. they serve breakfast daily to your room and anything else you require is right at your door step but with a nice bright drive way to distance yourself from the streets directly. i would recommend this place to all my friends!

name: Lucky Hotel Bangkok, Sukhumvit 26
detail: My room was clean, modern, and had a very comfortable bed.

name: ibis Styles Bangkok Silom
detail: The bed was comfortably firm and the linen squeaky clean.

name: Pullman Bangkok Hotel G
detail: I am a visitor from Hong Kong and stay at Pullman Hotel G. Yesterday was my first day to check in to the hotel, Unfortunately I found my luggage was wrongly pick up at the airport. I was feeling lost and don't know what to do at that moment cause me and my girl friend doesn't speak Thai-language, also I don't even have a contact of my airline. So I went back to the lobby and looking for HELP. One of your staff which stay at Bell Captain side call Ping heard my situation and started help me to found out the number of the airline and talk with them about my issue. After all the conversation done, Ping suggest me to take the wrong luggage back to airport first and let BFS to handle my case. While we sent back the luggage and go to travel around, it was mid-night when we back to hotel. Another Bell Captain JoJo was there and I was asked for help to tracking my case. It was 8 hours later since I sent back the luggage and seems no luck on it as JoJo mention after he help to call the BFS. JoJo said he will stay connect with the BFS and let me know any update if need. Finally, BFS call me one hour later and said mine luggage was back to the airport and will sent back to the hotel I live! The next day I go back to Bell Captain, NJ saw my letter which provide by the hotel and already know what am I think of. My luggage is back! It's really amazing on all of you guys which help me on this ultimate-scared case and I think the training and the empathy of your staff are very well. I will recommend all my friend who will be BangKoK to travel to come to Pullman Bangkok Hotel G ! Also, a concierge staff call OFF also help us to contact the Van we book cause the time on my booking time is complicated. Thanks for his help too. Finally, i was received a cheat call from bangkok, thanks for your staff GAM to help me translate and let them know we are not worth to cheat. Again, thank you so much for all of your staff which helps.

name: The Landmark Bangkok
detail: The property exceeded our expectations in every aspect.

name: S31 Sukhumvit Hotel
detail: We had two wonderful nights at this hotel. I doubt one can find another 5-Star hotel in Bangkok as good as this one for the same price. Certainly exceeded our expectations. All staff members are very professional and courteous. The gentlemen at the concierge are always there to greet when guests leave or enter the hotel. The hotel is very clean & beautifully decorated. Our room (deluxe) was spacious and had everything we needed. The bed was the biggest and most comfortable we’ve ever slept in! We didn’t have enough time to enjoy all amenities, but enjoyed the varied options at breakfast and the pianist that plays in the lobby area. I can not fault this hotel on anything. The location is perfect. Only a five-minute walk to the Emquartier mall and BTS. The only thing which was not so satisfactory is that we (non-smokers) were given a smoking room and unless the a/c was on the smell was really strong. I may have overlooked this detail whilst booking, so no fault of the hotel’s.

name: Grand Mercure Bangkok Atrium
detail: My wife and I stayed at the Amari Atrium Bangkok Hotel for 4 days. After being disappointed with a hotel we booked in Malaysia we were afraid that we might face the same sort of experience. But it was clear from the moment we got off the taxi that our stay at the Amari Atrium would be a pleasant one. As expected, it was. From the bell hop attending to your luggage, to a swift check in, for the people at the elevators helping us to find the right floor, we have not had a single day of bad experience. Even the service staff helped us understand the different between 'Sawadee krup' and 'Sawadee ka'! Can't be any more happier with our stay. Definitely a 5 star service!
